## Post-deploy result (fix 9beecb409ab, Gerrit change 3407)

Container `rebar-mcp-9beecb409abb-8093` (image `compose-mcp:9beecb409abba`, contains the fix), read-only SSM.

| | Old code idle (2026-11-16 19:47-20:11 UTC) | New code fresh start (00:10 UTC) | New code idle after gates (00:59 UTC) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Container anon | 1,273 MB | 230 MB | 328 MB |
| PID 1 RssAnon | 1,273 MB | 230 MB | 328 MB |
| glibc thread arenas | 703 MB (11 VMAs) | none | 21 MB (2 VMAs) |
| Other anon | 547 MB | 214 MB | 290 MB |
| Main heap | 22 MB | 13 MB | 14 MB |

Gate work on the new container (its own `docker logs`): 3 plan_review gates, silk-unpleasant-jackal (finished 00:22:46 and 00:32:30 UTC) and majestic-depilatory-beetle (00:47:05 UTC); GATE_PEAK_RSS 733,577,216 bytes, first-run peak delta 361 MB. Idle sample taken 730 s after the last gate, 0 tool calls in the prior 5 min, 4 threads; docker usage 828.5 MiB, file 462 MB, slab 198 MB.

Idle anon fell 74% versus the old-code idle baseline, and memory held in glibc thread arenas fell from 703 MB to 21 MB. About 98 MB stays above the fresh start, all in other anon (Python objects). That matches the per-gate-run object growth recorded in the 2026-11-16 comment (botocore service-model data, ~115k Python blocks per run), which `malloc_trim` cannot release; it is tracked as a follow-up.
